newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Prime Minister to visit New Zealand.
newsitem.headline: Australian Prime Minister to visit New Zealand.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Tuesday he would make an official visit to New Zealand in mid-February for his first meeting with counterpart Jim Bolger since the new New Zealand government was formed.
Howard said in a statement the visit would enable him to meet with members of the New Zealand government including Deputy Prime Minister Winston Peters.
It would also provide an opportunity for trade talks, he said.
"We are New Zealand's largest trading partner, while New Zealand ranks as Australia's third largest trading partner," Howard said.
"The visit will build on these strong links and also focus on other areas of shared interest and concern."
Howard would be in NZ from February 15 to 17.

The coalition NZ government was formed on December 10, after two months of uncertainty, when Peters' New Zealand First party finally consented to join with Bolger's conservative National Party in government.
